title: Pride Langkuk · Roxy BC
paragraphs: I help everyday people join our agency on BIGO Live, understand the rules, and grow at their own pace. Whether you have earned on the app before or you are just starting, you can talk to me directly.
Roxy Agency (Roxy BC) is an official BIGO agency partner — we are not BIGO itself. We teach, we guide, and we keep a WhatsApp group where you can drop questions and difficulties.
whyBullets: We guide new streamers. Little or no experience is okay.
Clear salary ladder and a referral promo for inviting new hosts.
A real WhatsApp group for questions, events and support.
Register only through our link, so you stay with us.
